summary: Delta-spec'd post-export native video share via Web Share API Level 2 files: retain File after download, Share button only when canShare({files}) is true, fresh user gesture required, AbortError=non-error, WebM MIME-honest gating, download kept. 10 mechanically testable ACs (AC-NS-1…AC-NS-10) in loop/spec-native-share.md. nextStage: architect.
goal: After downloading a climb replay MP4, allow the user to share it using Apple & Android native share controls.

learnings.insight: Web Share file share cannot ride the Export click: MediaRecorder encode is async and consumes user activation, so auto-share on encode complete throws NotAllowedError. Product requires retain File + a second Share tap after success.
learnings.action: Architect: extend success state to hold File/Blob+name+MIME until Dismiss/new export; wire Share only inside a click handler; never call navigator.share from recorder onstop.

learnings.insight: Share visibility must be gated with navigator.canShare({ files }) using files-only probe; desktop often returns false. AbortError from share() is cancel, not failure. WebM fallback must probe/share video/webm, not forge video/mp4.
learnings.action: Implement injectable canShare/share seams; AC-NS-1 negative hides control; AC-NS-5 treats AbortError as non-error; AC-NS-8 asserts MIME-honest File.type.

learnings.insight: Native-share delta defines 10 mechanically testable ACs (AC-NS-1…AC-NS-10) covering canShare gate, gesture negative, AbortError, non-abort error, retention/dismiss, WebM MIME, a11y announce, and download-still-happens regression.
learnings.action: Map each AC-NS-* to an invoked unit or browser check with fake canShare/share; reject source-text greps for navigator.share.

learnings.insight: Parent useReplayExport revokes the object URL ~1s after downloadBlob; retaining a shareable File may require keeping the Blob/File (not only the object URL) past that revoke window until Dismiss.
learnings.action: In architecture, separate download trigger revoke timing from share-retention lifetime; success status should carry or reference the retained File.

learnings.insight: Free-leaderboard trust-boundary ping remains open and out of scope for native share; this delta adds no server upload and no new score writes.
learnings.action: Do not mark F-1 / free-leaderboard AC closed. Confirm share path stays client-only File to OS sheet.

openQuestions: Exact Share button accessible name wording (default Share).
Optional title/text on share() payload (files required; probe files-only).
Auto-dismiss success after fulfilled share (default no; Future).
